# Best supportive care

Time to best supportive care (BSC) starts at first-line treatment initiation,
as specified in the SAP.  The derived endpoint retains a `bsc_date` column for
every cohort participant; participants without a recorded BSC start have an
explicit missing date.  Death before BSC is treated as censoring at the death
date for the cause-specific analysis, with `bsc_censor_reason` preserving that
distinction.  A supporting cumulative-incidence artifact may describe both
events when produced by the analysis stage.

```{r}
#| eval: false

source(here::here("analysis", "05-secondary", "secondary-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))

cohort <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"),
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "cohort_follow_up.yml")
)

# The time origin is the first-line treatment initiation, never randomization.
cohort$treatment_start_date <- secondary_parse_date(
  cohort$treatment_start_date, "treatment_start_date"
)
bsc_data <- cohort
bsc_data$bsc_origin_date <- bsc_data$treatment_start_date
bsc_data$bsc_date <- secondary_parse_date(bsc_data$bsc_date, "bsc_date")
bsc_data$follow_up_end_date <- secondary_date_column(
  bsc_data, "follow_up_end_date", "follow_up_end_date"
)
bsc_data$follow_up_end_date[is.na(bsc_data$follow_up_end_date)] <- as.Date("2026-08-21")
bsc_data$administrative_end <- pmin(bsc_data$follow_up_end_date, as.Date("2026-08-21"))
bsc_data$death_date <- secondary_date_column(bsc_data, "death_date", "death_date")
bsc_data$event_bsc <- 0L
bsc_data$bsc_censor_reason <- "administrative_end"
bsc_data$bsc_censor_date <- bsc_data$administrative_end
for (row in seq_len(nrow(bsc_data))) {
  bsc_before_death <- !is.na(bsc_data$bsc_date[row]) &&
    !is.na(bsc_data$bsc_origin_date[row]) &&
    bsc_data$bsc_date[row] >= bsc_data$bsc_origin_date[row] &&
    (is.na(bsc_data$death_date[row]) ||
       bsc_data$bsc_date[row] <= bsc_data$death_date[row])
  if (bsc_before_death && bsc_data$bsc_date[row] <= bsc_data$administrative_end[row]) {
    bsc_data$event_bsc[row] <- 1L
    bsc_data$bsc_censor_date[row] <- bsc_data$bsc_date[row]
    bsc_data$bsc_censor_reason[row] <- "bsc_observed"
  } else if (!is.na(bsc_data$death_date[row]) &&
             bsc_data$death_date[row] <= bsc_data$administrative_end[row] &&
             (is.na(bsc_data$bsc_date[row]) ||
                bsc_data$death_date[row] < bsc_data$bsc_date[row])) {
    # Death before BSC is censored at death for the cause-specific analysis.
    bsc_data$bsc_censor_date[row] <- bsc_data$death_date[row]
    bsc_data$bsc_censor_reason[row] <- "death_before_bsc"
  }
}
bsc_data$time_to_bsc_days <- as.numeric(
  pmax(0, bsc_data$bsc_censor_date - bsc_data$bsc_origin_date)
)
bsc_formula <- survival::Surv(time_to_bsc_days, event_bsc) ~ tx + age + diagnosis
bsc_fit <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
  formula = bsc_formula,
  data = bsc_data,
  basehaz = "ms",
  basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  seed = 17005
)
write_atomic_parquet(
  bsc_data[, c("id", "tx", "bsc_date", "time_to_bsc_days", "event_bsc",
               "bsc_censor_reason")],
  project_path("results", "secondary", "bsc", "endpoint.parquet")
)
```
